questions.question: What did Joshua, now old, urge the leaders to do?
options: March out to war against all the nations
Choose for themselves a king to rule over all the tribes
Build a great temple in the new land
Hold fast to the LORD and obey the law of Moses
questions.answer: Hold fast to the LORD and obey the law of Moses

questions.question: What warning did Joshua give about the remaining nations?
options: To take tribute from them but to spare all their lives
To drive them all out swiftly before the next harvest
Not to associate with them or their gods, lest a snare
To teach them the law of Moses and the whole covenant
questions.answer: Not to associate with them or their gods, lest a snare

questions.question: Joshua said one man of them would put a thousand to flight, because God fought for them.
Joshua warned that intermarrying with the nations would become a _____ to them.
Joshua said not one good _____ of the LORD had failed; all had come to pass.
